hard_boundaries: one authoring owner per skill asset
optimistic owner revision and source fingerprint required for every authoring transaction
derived projections are immutable and cannot be transaction targets
semantic task references only; no joint angle, PWM, torque or arbitrary controller code in IntentProtocol
independent SafetyAuthorityPort may revoke CODA authority and cannot be overridden by ordinary intent requests
AuthorityLease, ObservationFreshness, CommandValidity and Liveness are separate concepts
all references and commands bind epoch, generation, clock domain and finite validity
Adapter receipts are causal evidence and never grant writer authority
safety clear reports do not automatically restore a prior lease or generation
unsupported capability or missing profile refinement fails closed
no runtime claim of hardware safety from schema validation or game-visual evidence
